# Functional_Memory_Encoding

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
The process by which the spatial configuration of weights in a network maps to persistent functional states or memories. Guides the placement of memory elements in iNEST architectures to ensure robust, topology-aware information storage.
